Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do you find it as curious as I do that your menu has not changed since you opened in 1929?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: I know! It's awesome, right? It's our motto

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, in that case, I--

Name: Buford
Dialog: (pushes Baljeet out of the way) Step aside, weiner! One Windmill Dog, hold the bun.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (produces Buford's order) Excellent choice.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You saved my life.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It was nothing. (notices Buford bowing to Baljeet's feet) What are you doing?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I am your humble servant.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's the Bully Code. I live my life by it. (produces a card and gives it to Baljeet)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: "If a nerd shood save a bully's life, the bully is the nerd's slave for life." "Should" is misspelled.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Duh! It was written by bullies.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is very nice, but I do not want a slave.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Too bad, you got one.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Goodbye. (departs)

Name: Buford
Dialog: I will empty my mind of all thought, except for Baljeet. (stares at the ceiling for a moment) There, that was easy.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (walking along the streets of Danville) You are following me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: At a respectable distance, little master.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) So, what do you think?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: What am I looking at?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Duh, it's a new red shirt!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's from Jeremy! He sent me a picture. (looks at picture) Aw, look at his cute, little wiener hat. Let's send him a picture of me. Make sure you get my good side. How's the lighting? (Stacy takes the picture) Wait, you took it while I was still talking!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me see. (shows an ugly Candace) (gasps) I'd better erase that. (pushes button)

Name: Phone
Dialog: Picture sent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no! I hit the wrong button!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy Um, go into the menu and--

Name: Phone
Dialog: Picture sent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, not again!!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Here, let me see. (accidentally takes multiple pictures of Candace)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, no!! Stop!!!

Name: Phone
Dialog: Pictures sent.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm ruined.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Well, he's at work, so maybe he hasn't looked yet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We've got to get to Jeremy's phone, come on, we're going to Slushy Dog.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (while Ferb is showing blueprints to him) Peanut butter and jelly robot races, masking tape mummy gymnastics, a jelly bean monetary system for emerging nations...I don't know. I'm not feeling any of them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb are up to something, I'd better tell Mom.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, the photos. (She pushes her away.) Eyes on the prize.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Ah, Agent P. Sorry to disturb you on Canada Day, but the world's top evil scientists have been photographed leaving Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated. Something big is going on, real big. I need you to infiltrate his headquarters.

Name: Carl
Dialog: (off-screen) Ahem?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Sorry. We need you to infiltrate his headquarters. Carl thinks I need to be more "inclusive". Find out what he's up to!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Have you come to sign my cast? (over a close-up of said cast, with multiple signatures on it) Look, I saved you a spot right there. It says, "Save for Perry." Well, it was a bigger spot before I wrote, "Save for Perry," but there's some room there. Grab that marker.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha-ha! You've heard of the Internet? Well, this is uh... well, it's-it's just a net. But you're caught. (gets up and uses crutches to support him while he walks along) In exactly thirty minutes, the Tutti McFrutti ice cream man will park his truck in front of my building. I know, because I was standing there yesterday when HE RAN OVER MY FOOT! But today, I will reek my horrible vengeance! Behold, the Re-tire-Inator! Because, you know, he ran over my foot with the tire, and I'm going to hit him with a giant tire. Re-tire. It's-It's not like a retire, like stop working. It's not that Retire-Inator. That's-that's actually over there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I've got it ready. It's filled with crossword puzzles, and a big, fat, house cat that will lay on my belly and warm me into my...senior years. (Pause) Anyhoo, where was I? Oh, yes. Evil laugh. (laughs manically)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little Master, I've washed all your dust jackets and dusted all your cold knick-knacks.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (over a shot of various foods placed on a bookshelf) Those are not knick-knacks! They are food, and they should be in the refrigerator!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ohh, I have disappointed you, Little Master. I will strive to do better.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not strive for anything, and I am not your little master.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I'll just fluff up your pillow, then! (Baljeet runs away) Little Master? Little Master?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Stay away from me!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (runs up) Phineas! Ferb! I saved Buford's life, and now because of the Bully Code, he is my personal servant! It is driving me crazy! You have got to help me!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, okay. We just have to get Buford to save your life, and you'll be even.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: But how?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I see Jeremy's phone.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Where?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There! His message light is still blinking. That means he hasn't retrieved his pictures yet!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, let's just...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: What are you two doing here? I mean, not that I don't like surprise visits from you, but this room is for Slushy Dawg employees only.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're Slushy Dawg employees.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: We are?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah. We did our training at the downtown branch to surprise you. (beat) Surprise.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, that's rad!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace, I have absolutely no idea what I'm doing. What are all these buttons for?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's hot dogs. How hard can it be? (gives Stacy some fries) Here, fry something. I'm gonna go etgay the onephay. (runs off)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ugh, you know I don't speak Spanish!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, Candace, I see you've sent me some pictures. I can't wait to check 'em out later when I take my break.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (fake smiling) Yeah! (frowning) No!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I found out what all the buttons are for.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes. This thing is definitely the thing! What is this thing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This contraption, my friend, is completely foolproof.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let me explain. You'll "accidentally" step on to that platform, which will launch you up and over that flight of stairs, where you'll be kicked and rocketed through a piece of sheet-rock onto a trampoline. Then conveyor belted up to a rotating system that will drop you onto a spring, bouncing you all the way to that red X, where Buford will be standing, waiting to catch you, saving your life.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, I am thoroughly terrified, yet tingling with excitement!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (offscreen) Candace? (walks up to her with headphones) While I check the stockroom, can you take the drive-thru orders?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, my favorite!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on speakerbox) Uh, welcome to Slushy Dawg, can I take your order?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? You work here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom?! You eat here?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honey, where are you? (waves) Can you see me? Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh— (walks over to Stacy) This is weird. My mom's here.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I think your brothers are, too. Across the street.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are they up to?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (on headphones) Candace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? Mom! Drive up to the window! You gotta see what the boys are doing!

Name: Linda
Dialog: The boys are here, too? Hon, I'm boxed in. I've got a heck of a line in front of me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fill orders, fill orders. (takes and gives a bag) Hi, enjoy your meal. (to the next car) Come again. Enjoy your meal. Bon appétit.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Baljeet. You just stand on that platform and when Buford comes along, we'll guide him to the right spot. Although, it has occurred to us that you're giving up something really cool here.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You're spending all this energy trying to stop Buford from being your faithful servant, when the reality is having the biggest, toughest kid in town (Ferb nods) as your personal bodyguard is a sign of supreme coolness.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Really?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, think about it.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm, maybe you are right.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Ooh, hear that, Perry the Platypus?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tootie McFrutti has arrived on time! In a few seconds, he'll be flattened by a speeding tire.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh no! Oh no no no! (The inator hits Doof's good foot.) OW!!! NO!!! Oh, my good foot! My good foot! OW! Ow ow! My bad foot! Oh, my good foot again! Oh, no, my bad foot—Oh, this is really a vicious cycle!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace, I'm takin' my break now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-huh. (laughs nervously)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, we gotta get Mom up here so she can see what the boys are doing. Keep throwing food out the window! (she leaves)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Jeremy, can I borrow your phone? Thanks. Erase photos bust boys erase photos bust boys!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little Master, Little Master, I finished color-coding all of your overalls. Whadaya want me to do next?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Well, first, I would like you to iron all of my books, then perhaps polish my retainer, then you can start my college applications. Massage my toosties. Sew my name onto my underwear, organize my book reports by subject. Ooh, build me—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Weenie! (Buford pushes Baljeet out of the way.) Alright, we're even.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: What? Aw, man.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! All photos erased! Now, onto the boys! (runs up to the gang) Hey, just so you know, Mom's on her waaaaaaaay— (Candace steps on the platform and the contraption activates.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oops.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Stacy, you're here, too?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah. Candace wants you to go out front to see what the boys are doing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, just give me a chili dog and I'll be on my way.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sheetrock. (Crash!) Trampoline.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I saved your life. Now you're my servant.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, all right, ew! (gets up)

Name: Buford
Dialog: But the code! You've got no honor!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, wow! You okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um, yeah. Here's your phone.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (flips it open) There's a picture on it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No no!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, that's a great photo of you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Phew!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Now about your job...

Name: Candace
Dialog: No worries. I quit.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, you guys wanna hit Slushy Dawg before we go home?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ew!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Oh, heavens, no. Slushy Dawgs never get any better.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace? Boys? (looks at the contraption) Hmm. (beat) I'll never understand public art.
